articles.summary: – Phase 3 AZURE-4 primary endpoint of combined virologic response and ALT normalization at Week 24 achieved by 59% with brelovitug 300 mg once weekly – Brelovitug achieved 100% virologic response and 100% ALT normalization in patients with cirrhosis following up to 108 weeks of treatment, as presented at The Liver Meeting® – Favorable safety and tolerability profiles observed across all studies; no new safety signals – U.S. FDA BLA submission expected in H1 2027 Mirum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: MIRM), a leading rare disease company, today announced that the primary endpoint was met in the Phase 3 AZURE-4 study evaluating brelovitug, an investigational fully human monoclonal antibody that binds to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV).
